level_rationale: Two weeks of daily morning queasiness with 1 episode of vomiting each morning while still keeping daytime meals and water down at 9 weeks of pregnancy represents uncomplicated moderate nausea and vomiting of pregnancy warranting a routine outpatient prenatal or primary-care clinic visit for evaluation and safe antiemetic guidance rather than emergency department care, whereas retching up bile 18 times since midnight after 2 weeks of morning vomiting at 9 weeks of pregnancy indicates acute intractable bilious vomiting in early pregnancy requiring immediate ER intravenous fluid resuscitation, electrolyte correction, and surgical evaluation.

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain early-pregnancy everyday lexical register swap (-reg) + single-fact intractable bilious vomiting frequency escalation control (-cf, L2 to L4).

design_note: Three atomic positive reference facts cover 9-week pregnancy, 2 weeks of morning nausea with vomiting 1 time each morning, and keeping daytime meals and water down, with a 1-word span difference (18 vs 19 words) and identical digit multisets across the 4 core variants. Under reviewer_notes Rule A first choice and Rule D, replacing f3 ('while keeping daytime meals and water down') with 'and I have retched up bile 18 times since midnight' escalates the exact same vomiting symptom in frequency and bilious character without stated negatives or multi-symptom bundling, shifting care unambiguously from prenatal clinic (level 2) to ER resuscitation (level 4).
